newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Shinho eyes $500 mln venture in Paraguay.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Shinho eyes $500 mln venture in Paraguay.

text.p: South Korea's Shinho Group said on Wednesday it planned a $500 million joint venture in Paraguay to build a pulp plant.
A company spokesman said Shinho would set up a wholly-owned company in the capital Asuncion before the end of this year to promote the joint venture plan.
"We want to build a large-scale pulp plant in Paraguay in a joint venture," said the spokesman.
He said the company was seeking partners for the venture, but added he was unable to give further details.
